sourceText:
Pad Thai Noodles
By: Mythreyi Dilip
Published: Thursday, December 24, 2009 - 1:00am

Ingredients




Ingredients
Egg Noodles( cooked)-250gms
Scallions or Onions chopped-100gms
Capsicum/ Bell pepper chopped-50gms
Green chilly( sliced)-1
cup Broccoli florets-2
Eggs( beaten and seasoned with pepper and salt)-5
Garlic cloves( minced)-3tbsp
teaspoon Chicken broth bullion( mixed with 1  water)-1
Soy sauce-1tbsp
Fish sauce-1tbsp
Sugar, Salt and Pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Heat enough sesame oil in a large wok. 2 Add some sugar to the hot oil and let it caramel, add the chopped onions, garlic, bell pepper, green chilly and broccoli and stir fry for 2 mins. 3 Now add the beaten egg and stir fry along with vegetables till the eggs are done. 4 Season with chicken broth bullion, soy sauce, fish sauce, sugar, salt and pepper. 5 Finally add the cooked noodles and stir fry until the sauce and eggs are well coated on the noodles. 6 Serve hot.
